messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Lyons Financial (enterprise/lyons-vpc) 
incident-bot: symptom=dedicated-pool evictions + increased 5xx for model lyons/13b-prod; severity=page; page=@oncall
emma-ng: got it, i'm on call. confirming customer impact before paging CS. miguel can you share initial signal? :running:
sanjay: seeing repeated OOM eviction events on pool=lyons-pay-prod around 11:02-11:08 UTC. KV cache churn + large batch window. tail logs show GPU OOM then pod restart. no full region outage but ~8% error rate for tenant traffic.
miguel-rodriguez: confirmed. pod node-gpu-4 hit oom, restarted 3x in 6m. logs: ```[2026-03-17T11:02:14Z] OOM killed process inference_worker pid=2345 mem=95%```
amir-khan: ping — Lyons CS: reports elevated errors for payment verification models, some users experiencing 504. They want ETA, mitigation ASAP. I've opened support ticket SF-2821.
hana-ops: can we apply tenant-level isolation? recommended: quarantine lyons tenant routing to fallback pool (safe-variant) while we stabilize. safe variant = lyons/13b-safe-v1 (reduced context, smaller batch).
emma-ng: decision: enable tenant quarantine and pin to safe variant now, then scale up capacity if needed. miguel/sanjay, implement and post commands. i'll update customer.
sanjay: applying routing override. patch (one-liner): ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS" -d '{"tenant":"lyons","pin_model":"lyons/13b-safe-v1","route_pool":"dedicated-safe","ttl":3600}'``` will run now.
miguel-rodriguez: also queueing a targeted burst scale on dedicated-safe pool: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment/dedicated-safe --replicas=6``` monitoring evictions & 5xx.
hana-ops: thanks — set cache bypass for lyons to avoid large prefix cache hotness: ```route-config: bypass_cache: true``` (short-term).
amir-khan: telling CS: "We've quarantined traffic to a safe model variant and are scaling capacity. Expect reduced errors within ~5-10m. We'll follow up with root cause timeline." :thumbsup:
emma-ng: handing oncall to miguel for active stabilization, i'll stay in thread for customer comms. miguel, update every 10m or on state change.
miguel-rodriguez: taking dispatch. current error rate down from 8% -> 3% after pin, still watching. running eviction audit script now.
sanjay: note for postmortem: root likely workload-specific batching config + model memory regression after last rollout. recommend blocking that model from autoscaling packs until we patch quantization kernel.
\em ma-ng: (typo fixed) emma-ng: noted. hana, please prepare safe-variant verification checklist for rollback window.
hana-ops: checklist: 1) validate output quality vs baseline prompts 2) confirm latency SLOs 3) confirm tokenization parity 4) verify no credential/exposure changes. will run quick sampling and post results.
miguel-rodriguez: eviction audit done — three pods evicted, artifact attached to ticket SF-2821 (logs + pod IDs). re-checking once scale finishes.
emma-ng: customer notified, next update in 10. thanks team. :heart:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity lowered to mitigated (actions applied: tenant quarantine + safe-variant pin). log incident ID=INC-4623456789.
emma-ng: closing active page to oncall rotation, miguel keep monitoring for 60m and escalate if >2% errors persist.
miguel-rodriguez: will monitor. logging follow-up action items for postmortem: blocklist faulty kernel rollout, add tenant-specific memory guard, improve autoscale surge limits for dedicated pools.
amir-khan: confirming CS will send customer summary once we have incident RCA draft.
